summary: A driver who refused to yield led officers on a prolonged pursuit along Madison Street. Speeds climbed to about 55 mph with no pedestrians or other traffic on the roadway, and there was a brief concern over a possible gunshot as the chase continued north.

A man was accused of attacking his girlfriend with scissors and throwing a vase at her hand during a domestic dispute, leaving minor injuries. Officers and medical units responded to the residence, where juveniles were present and one reported a nosebleed. A caller disputed a claim that one of the juveniles was pregnant.

area: near Edwards Air Force Base, eastern Kern County
summary: Reports of smoke from a building drew a large assignment including multiple engines and a battalion in the Edwards Air Force Base area. Crews found only light residual smoke extending into the attic, cancelled reinforcements and reduced the response to a regular structure fire.

An employee watching surveillance footage saw two hooded males force their way into a business and begin taking items. The employee then lost connection to the cameras, possibly because they had been removed by the suspects.

Domestic incident in progress — a caller could be heard yelling in the background before the suspect began chasing her. Officers responded; the caller reported being struck in the 21st and D Street area.
Report of an attempted assault with a knife on Union Avenue. The described suspect, under the influence, was said to be in possession of a pocket knife. Officers responding.

area: Beach Park and Mill Creek Park, near the Kern River
summary: After a report that a vehicle had been taken, officers tracked a subject through Beach Park and Mill Creek Park toward the Kern River and made contact near the parks.
Female caller on an open line reported a man had tried to strangle her during an active verbal dispute. The subject was last seen gathering belongings outside the residence.
A woman told dispatchers she had been hit with a baseball bat and had an injury to her leg, but then declined to file a report and said she was leaving.
Report of an outside fire on E Street; crews dispatched.
Welfare check for a possible child-endangerment matter in which a juvenile said an older brother had choked him and covered his mouth. Officers responding.

area: Highway 33 south of Petroleum Club Road
summary: A sedan ran off the roadway on southbound Highway 33 in the Maricopa area and struck a guardrail. CHP responding.
Medical and fire units responded to an unknown medical call on Wooner Drive.
A white service truck was reported swerving and unable to maintain its lane after exiting the freeway, possibly a DUI. Units checked the area.
